scope: Externally clamped artificial neuron fixture for early joint activation and later partial-cue pattern completion. Original fixed-AND scores are retained as fixture scores, not general stability labels; no PCM/RGB/autonomous knowledge or navigation claim.
group_placement: Each named ensemble occupies the first N cells of its own original40-cell inhibitory site. This idealized placement avoids local target feedback on the preceding input; real mixed sensory ensembles need separate validation.
training_semantics: Every adjacent pair of the listed timeline is passed to original PFC.学习. A+B->C and A+D->E each occur once per recipe; C->F and E->G twice. Blank frames avoid an accidental terminal-to-next-example transition; no edge is assigned its expected answer.

per_cell_archive.lookup: Each probe stage array_row selects the exact per-cell row. margin=excitation-(original firing threshold+net inhibition).

analytic_limits.unconditional_growth: Below warning edge count, each frequently repeated AB->C edge is repetitions*increment. Finite fixed thresholds cannot keep a single input below threshold for arbitrarily many repeats.
analytic_limits.boundary: Decay limits hold only for the declared stationary14-step repeated schedule. Relative exposure frequency and forgetting remain consequential.
analytic_limits.interpretation_scope: 以上无界累加与有限门槛推导只说明不能永久强制同一AND真值表；不说明单线索补全是异常。实际稳定性需按旧新内容、明确冲突情境区分和可用动态活动单独验收。

interpretation_correction.reason: 用户指出重复AB→C后A独自激活C可属于正常联想补全/自动化。原夹具没有A单独出现却不应激活C的训练证据，不能把预设AND表评分不符直接解释为模型异常或不稳定。
interpretation_correction.measurement_policy: 只修订解释。全部旧cases、equal_exposure_serial_control、blank_experience_retention及NPZ逐值保留；未重新训练、运行神经微步或补写实验。
interpretation_correction.original_scoring_semantics: conjunction_pass/serial_pass/all_pass/failed_probes/exact_expected_activity沿用原人工真值表评分；False表示不等于该表要求的精确活动集合，不表示没有发生联想、无法串联或整体模型不稳定。名称含wrong的probe也只是该人工表的标签。
interpretation_correction.missing_training_evidence: 训练只包含正向AB→C与AD→E等共现；没有A→非C、B→非C或明确互斥冲突情境的教学。所有联想不必永远要求两个条件。
interpretation_correction.pattern_completion_interpretation: 部分线索达到门槛后可补全共同经历的后继，属于联想自动化的能力例证。A同时属于AB和AD两套经历，所以A单独激活C与E是多个相容回忆，不应在缺少排除性经历时直接判错。

composed_partial_cue_chain.description: 固定强化.055、N24、强度1、重复3次的已测B→C和C→F微步能够相接。
composed_partial_cue_chain.evidence_boundary: 这是对同一原表已有两条微步记录的状态对齐推断，不是新跑了一条B→C→F轨迹。这里减少启动所需的线索，没有测到B→F直连或内部步数减少。

stability_acceptance_criteria: 持续新学习时，先前能够唤起的旧内容与新内容均可在相应经历线索下保留。
训练确实提供互斥或冲突情境时，能依据相应上下文区分后继，避免不合经历的干扰。
活动与电流维持可用范围，能够随新输入改变；避免持续全激活或依靠全熄灭获得表面稳定。
interpretation_correction.remaining_boundaries: 人工细胞共现展示局部机制，尚未证明真实感觉知识、导航逻辑或语言自动化。边权增长值得独立监测，但不能仅凭单条件激活证明失稳。统一衰减后的已学线索不可唤起是另一项真实测量，仍只在本夹具范围内解释。
